newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin hails Hong Kong handover.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin hails Hong Kong handover.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin congratulated Beijing on retaking control over Hong Kong after 156 years of the British rule, the presidential press service said on Monday.

"I express confidence that after restoring China's jurisdiction over Xianggang (Hong Kong) this territory will remain the flourishing financial and economic centre of Asia and the whole world," the press office quoted Yeltsin's letter to Chinese President Jiang Zemin as saying.

"This will show the effectiveness of Deng Xiaoping's concept of 'one state - two systems'," Yeltsin added referring to the ideas of the late Beijing leader who had promoted the creation of free trade zones in the communist-controlled China.

Moscow and Beijing are actively improving their relations after decades of hostility caused by rivalry for supremacy in the communist world. Jian visited Moscow earlier this year and Yeltsin is expected to go to Beijing later this year.
Yeltsin sent Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov to attend handover ceremonies which climaxed at midnight (1600 GMT on Monday)
